title: Biggest Games Coming Before 2026 Ends | Resident Evil, Zelda, GTA 6, Minecraft and More
description: Every big game with a confirmed release date from mid October to December 2026, including Resident Evil on Switch 2, Final Fantasy Resonance, Minecraft on Switch 2, the Ocarina of Time remake and Grand Theft Auto 6.

sections.heading: The last stretch of twenty twenty six
sections.script: The end of twenty twenty six is packed with games. In this video we go through the biggest releases with confirmed dates, from the middle of October to the middle of December. There are three Resident Evil classics arriving on Nintendo Switch 2, a new Final Fantasy, Minecraft on Switch 2, an Ocarina of Time remake, and of course Grand Theft Auto six. We checked every date against publisher announcements and at least one more trusted source. A quick note first: release dates can change, and some stores show a day earlier or later depending on your time zone, so always check the store page before you plan your weekend.

sections.heading: October sixteenth: Resident Evil on Switch 2
sections.script: First up, on October sixteenth, Capcom is bringing three Resident Evil games to the Nintendo Switch 2. They are the Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition, Resident Evil 3, and the Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition. Capcom revealed them during a Nintendo Direct in early September, and they are digital releases on the Nintendo eShop. According to Nintendo Life, cloud versions of Resident Evil 2 and 3 were released on the original Switch, but these are native ports, and it is the first time Nintendo players can get the Resident Evil 4 remake. The Deluxe Edition of Resident Evil 2 includes previously released extra content, and the Gold Edition of Resident Evil 4 adds the Separate Ways story. It is perfect timing for Halloween. And if you want something brand new, Resident Evil Requiem, the newest main game, launched in February and passed five million copies in about five days.

sections.heading: October twenty second: Final Fantasy Resonance
sections.script: On October twenty second, Square Enix releases Final Fantasy Resonance on Nintendo Switch 2, Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC. It is based on the first story chapter of the mobile game Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, but Square Enix says it has been rebuilt as a full console quality role playing game, and it uses the HD two D style of pixel art with modern lighting. A free demo is already available on the announced platforms, so you can try it before you buy. The same day, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is also listed for Switch 2, if you want something lighter to play with family.

sections.heading: October twenty third: Modern Warfare four
sections.script: Activision's Call of Duty Modern Warfare four launches on Friday, October twenty third. It is coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2, and Activision says Infinity Ward is working with the studio Digital Legends to make a native version for Switch 2. It is not coming to PlayStation 4 or Xbox One, so owners of older consoles will need an upgrade. Activision announced the game in May twenty twenty six, and a PC trailer with technical details followed in September. The date is shown on Activision's own blog and on the Xbox store page, so you can be confident about it.

sections.heading: October twenty seventh: Minecraft on Switch 2
sections.script: Minecraft gets a native Nintendo Switch 2 version on October twenty seventh. Mojang and Nintendo announced the date in August, and Mojang repeated it at Minecraft Live in September. The Switch 2 version supports Vibrant Visuals, the graphics upgrade with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Mojang also says that if you already own the digital Switch version, you can pre-order the Switch 2 Standard Edition for free until the end of January twenty twenty seven in most territories, through the Nintendo eShop. After more than three hundred million copies sold across all platforms, Minecraft keeps finding new ways to reach players. If you have always wanted to see the Nether in better lighting, this is your chance.

sections.heading: October twenty ninth: two big arrivals
sections.script: October twenty ninth is a big day. Phantom Blade Zero from S-Game launches on PlayStation 5 and PC. It was first planned for September ninth, then moved back to give the team extra time to polish the game, and pre-orders list the standard edition at fifty nine dollars and ninety nine cents and the deluxe edition at sixty nine dollars and ninety nine cents. Some Steam pages may show October twenty eighth because of time zones. The same day, Telltale releases The Wolf Among Us Remastered, a new look for its popular detective story, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, Switch and PC. Fans of story driven games should mark this date.

sections.heading: November fifth: Ocarina of Time returns
sections.script: On November fifth, The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time returns as a remake for Nintendo Switch 2. Nintendo revealed the date in September, and it costs fifty nine dollars and ninety nine cents digitally, or sixty nine dollars and ninety nine cents for a physical copy. The remake has completely overhauled visuals, fully voiced cutscenes, a reworked camera and a symphonic orchestral soundtrack. You can even play or hum the Ocarina songs into the Switch 2's built in microphone to make Link perform them. Nintendo is also planning a playable ocarina accessory later this year. A week earlier, on October twenty ninth, Nintendo releases a special Zelda fortieth anniversary edition of the Switch 2 console, with a Triforce design.

sections.heading: November nineteenth: Grand Theft Auto six
sections.script: The biggest date of all is November nineteenth. Rockstar Games has set Grand Theft Auto six to launch on Thursday, November nineteenth, twenty twenty six, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. The game returns to Vice City and the state of Leonida, and it has already been delayed twice, so Rockstar's latest announcement settled the date. There is no PC release date yet, and Rockstar has not confirmed one, so PC players will have to wait for news. The PlayStation Store lists the same date, and Rockstar published the announcement on its own newswire. Whatever platform you play on, clear your calendar.

sections.heading: More dates to mark
sections.script: There are plenty of other dates worth noting. Planet Zoo two, the zoo building sequel, arrives on October thirteenth for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox, and Castlevania Belmont's Curse follows on October fifteenth. On November twelfth, Metaphor ReFantazio and the Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition both land on Switch 2. In early December, on December third, Xenoblade Chronicles 3 gets a Switch 2 Edition, and Rayman Legends Retold arrives. Switch 2 owners in particular have a lot to look forward to this holiday season, so keep your eShop wishlist handy.

sections.heading: December: Monster Hunter, Layton and Path of Exile
sections.script: December is lighter, but it has some great games. Monster Hunter Wilds comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on December fourth, with Capcom confirming the date in a September Nintendo Direct. Pre-orders open on the Nintendo eShop on October nineteenth, and the Switch 2 version includes all the free title updates, local wireless play and cross play. The Ascendance expansion is planned for Switch 2 in twenty twenty seven. On December tenth, Professor Layton and the New World of Steam launches on PlayStation 5, Switch 2, Switch and PC, bringing the puzzle adventure series back after a long break. And on December eleventh, Path of Exile two leaves early access with its full one point zero release on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S and PC. It becomes fully free to play, with optional purchases for cosmetics and extra storage, and it adds the sword wielding Duelist class and the final two story acts.

sections.heading: What are you playing
sections.script: That is our guide to the biggest games arriving before the end of twenty twenty six. Remember, dates can change, so check the official store pages and publisher announcements before you plan. Now we want to know which game you are most excited about. Is it the Resident Evil trio on Switch 2, Minecraft, Ocarina of Time, or Grand Theft Auto six? Tell us in the comments below, and subscribe to the channel for more gaming news, guides and history.
